_: guardians_le on Pincredibles' 'Guardians of the Galaxy' 2.1.1 (cGameName gotg_2020, VPUniverse),
a scripted tribute with PinUP Player: vpxshadow.py keeps its script as a shadow game
and hands the ball to the real game. The table is a Premium/LE playfield: both
spinners (Ronan, Drax), the Orb behind its drop target, Rocket's kicker, Groot's
mouth and lock - so the LE is the card it matches (`preferred`); the Pro map is the
same table on a Pro card (no spinners there).
Switches by NAME through this card's switch_list.txt; coils [node, index] from
device_xy.txt (group 72 = node 8, 73 = node 9). Shot names: Yondu = LEFT LANE,
Ronan = LEFT ORBIT, Rocket = Rocket's kicker (the machine's KICKBACK coil and opto,
node 9), Nebula = LEFT RAMP, Groot, Broker = ORB, Gamora = RIGHT RAMP,
Drax = RIGHT ORBIT, Star-Lord = RIGHT SCOOP.
Mechs in extra_vbs: Groot's trough is a 4-switch ball stack swapped in for the
generated saucer on the first slow update; his mouth stays open; the Orb's drop
target follows CENTER DROP TARGET-UP/DOWN and its inside target stands back up.
PuPInit is quieted and PadNoPuP always stands in for PinUP Player (the table's
PuPInit calls puplayer.getroot, which the stub lacks).

extra_vbs:
'---- PAD (map extra_vbs): GOTG's mechs, driven by the machine's coils
Sub PadRightScoop(e)
	If e Then
		bsLeftScoop.SolOut True
		LeftScoopK.IsDropped = 0
		vpmTimer.AddTimer 100, "LeftScoopK.IsDropped = 1 '"
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadOrbDropUp(e)
	If e Then
		OrbTarget1.IsDropped = False
		Controller.Switch(1047) = False
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadOrbDropDown(e)
	If e Then
		OrbTarget1.IsDropped = True
		Controller.Switch(1047) = True
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadOrbitGates(e)
	LoopGateLeft.Open = e
	Gate002.Open = e
End Sub

' Groot's mouth stays open (the machine's jaw is a node-board motor the table
' cannot follow) and his trough holds up to four balls on GROOT TROUGH 1..4;
' the inside-the-Orb target stands back up (the machine's is a standup); the
' Orb's blocking wall stays out of the way. Run from vpmTimer's slow updates.
Class PadGotgMechs
	Private mSwapped, mOrbDown
	Private Sub Class_Initialize
		mSwapped = False
		mOrbDown = 0
	End Sub
	Public Sub Reset
	End Sub
	Public Sub Update
		If Not mSwapped Then
			If IsObject(bsGrootKicker) Then
				Set bsGrootKicker = PadGrootStack
				mSwapped = True
			End If
		End If
		If GrootMouth.Collidable Then
			GrootMouth.Collidable = False
			GrootMouth.Z = -30
		End If
		If OrbTarget1Disabled.Collidable Then
			OrbTarget1Disabled.Collidable = False
		End If
		If OrbTarget2.IsDropped Then
			mOrbDown = mOrbDown + 1
			If mOrbDown > 15 Then
				OrbTarget2.IsDropped = False
				mOrbDown = 0
			End If
		Else
			mOrbDown = 0
		End If
	End Sub
End Class
Dim PadGrootStack : Set PadGrootStack = New cvpmBallStack
PadGrootStack.InitSw 0, 1072, 1073, 1074, 1075, 0, 0, 0
PadGrootStack.InitKick GrootKicker, 180, 20
PadGrootStack.IsTrough = False
Dim PadMechs : Set PadMechs = New PadGotgMechs
vpmTimer.EnableUpdate PadMechs, False, True

' PinUP Player is the shadow game's display; the machine's LCD is the real one
Set PuPlayer = New PadNoPuP
